name: away_setback_deferred_until_whf_stops_and_window_closes__whf
description: [whole-house-fan; Issue #1193] Away setback during whole-house-fan ventilation. The house is ventilated by the fan from 10:00; the occupant leaves at 15:00 (setback refused by rule 2, the fan keeps cooling the empty house); at 16:00 outdoor air turns warmer than indoor so the fan session ends -- the window is still open, so HVAC stays paused (rule 3, nothing is commanded); at 17:00 the window is closed and the away setback (79F cool edge) lands. Occupant outcome: no AC is run against an open window, and the empty house is not held at the comfort ceiling once sealed.
source: Issue #1193: whole-house-fan extension of golden 'away_with_active_natvent_transition' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured) pinning the deferral of the away setback.
notes: whole_house_fan twin (Issue #1193): with a whole-house fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air runs the fan and suppresses HVAC (rule 2: fan and HVAC never together).

events.note: Hot-day classification at home (classifier derives cool for a hot day)
Window opens: nat-vent activates (outdoor 65F < indoor 73.5F, below threshold 77F)
User leaves. Production: only setpoint changes to setback_cool. Nat-vent continues.
Outdoor (78F) now warmer than indoor (75F): free cooling is over, the whole-house-fan session ends. Window still open.
Window closed while away: the door/window pause ends and the away setback can finally apply.

assertions.reason: sensor_open: outdoor 65F < indoor 73.5F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, outdoor within threshold -- whole-house fan starts, HVAC suppressed (rule 2).
Rule 2: the away setback is refused while the whole-house fan runs. It is deferred, not applied.
Outdoor 78F > indoor 75F: the fan session ends. The window is still open, so the thermostat is not given a cool command (rule 3); the exit is paused, not restored.

Window closed at 17:00 while away: the pause ends and the deferred away setback (setback_cool=79F) is applied -- the setback lands once the fan has stopped and the house is sealed, not at the comfort ceiling 74F.

verdict.summary: Away setback refused while a whole-house fan runs (rule 2), HVAC stays paused while the window is open after the fan stops (rule 3), and the 79F setback lands when the window closes
verdict.observed_behavior: Production v0.8.22: hvac_write_blocked_whf_active at 15:00; nat_vent_outdoor_rise_exit at 16:00 with _paused_by_door True and no climate command; set_temperature 79F at 17:00
